tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms & conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have satisfactorily supplied the above items for Rs.17.39Lakhs and above to any thermal power plants/process industries/cement companies etc, and shall furnish single/multiple purchase order copy/s as a proof issued by chief engineer/project head/competent authority.
The bidder shall be a manufacturer/authorized dealer/Supplier of Spun CI pipes.Relevant document shall be furnished.

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs.34.78Lakhs in at least two financial years, in the preceding five financial years i.e., 2025-24, 2023-24, 2022-23, 2021-22 & 2020-21. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual turnover certificate, balance sheet and profit & loss account statements duly certified by a chartered accountant.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Profit & Loss Statement/ Annual turnover certified by CA

itemList.specifications: Specification:Spun cast iron pipe size 200NB with hardness of BHN 300 minimum hydrostatic test to ISO 1536/BS 12111 CLASS D. standard legth 5.2/5.4 mtr.
